title: Quick Brazilian Prune Skewers
description: A light and flavorful Brazilian dish featuring prunes, perfect for a quick snack or dessert. This halal-friendly recipe uses binchotan-charcoal for a unique smoky flavor.
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes before grilling.
Preheat a wok over medium heat with the binchotan charcoal piece inside.
Thread 2-3 prunes onto each bamboo skewer.
Grill the prune skewers for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until slightly charred.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, honey, lemon juice, and salt.
Brush the coconut milk mixture onto the grilled prune skewers.
Serve the prune skewers warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Repeat the grilling and brushing process for the remaining prune skewers.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving.
